# Reachability, defined once in the system prompt, is asked once per CVE; a
# not_reachable answer sets Opportunity to 0, Ease of exploit to 1 and the
# four technical impacts to their lowest levels without asking them: LC 2,
# LI 1, LAV 1, and LAC the lowest of its traceability column, 7 under the
# quickstart's per_request and 1 under per_individual. Loss of
# confidentiality, integrity and availability list no_impact below their
# scale, read as an answer, never as cannot_tell, at the same floors. Every
# vector stays one the calculator takes.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg --config-file=$QUICKSTART/config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'Scoring run finished'
vex-vectors out.cdx.json 45
below-scale dbg LC=2 LI=1 LAV=1 LAC=7

exec sh -c 'cat dbg/run-*/batch-00001.system.prompt'
stdout 'A vulnerability is reachable here when this deployment, as it is deployed, runs its vulnerable code'
stdout 'Choose cannot_tell only when the facts given do not decide between the other answers'

exec sh -c 'sed "s/traceability: \"per_request\"/traceability: \"per_individual\"/" "$QUICKSTART/config.yaml" > individual.yaml'
grep 'traceability: "per_individual"' individual.yaml
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg2 --config-file=individual.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json out2.cdx.json
vex-vectors out2.cdx.json 45
below-scale dbg2 LC=2 LI=1 LAV=1 LAC=1
